tools.name: transcribe_video
tools.description: Fetch the full transcript of a public video (Instagram, TikTok, Facebook and most other platforms) with timestamps. Returns plain text. Costs 1 Spark; get a code with 5 free Sparks at clipflint.online.

findings.title: Read-only tool requests dangerous parameters
findings.detail: Tool "transcribe_video" appears informational but accepts parameters (code) that enable code/file/secret access.
